elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 states that the Company owns all work product created for it, including the defined Deliverables.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly assigns all right, title and interest in the Deliverables, defined to encompass the work product described.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 expressly states that HDI retains its pre-existing intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The licence to HDI intellectual property embedded in the Deliverables is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Company expressly retains all rights in the Content and all user, customer and order data generated through the Site.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: No licence or other right in the Company's Content or site data is granted to HDI, so the condition requiring limitation of any such licence is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: Section 5.5 expressly states that the Parties shall not jointly own any intellectual property.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: HDI retains only its pre-existing intellectual property; there is no express reservation for generic tools or know-how generally, including any developed under the Agreement.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The Company receives outright ownership of the Deliverables, and the necessary licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The Company receives an outright assignment of the Deliverables, and the licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: Neither the assignment nor the licence to embedded HDI intellectual property expressly states that the rights are worldwide.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The Company owns the Deliverables outright, and its licence to embedded HDI intellectual property is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Although the Company owns the Deliverables, the retained embedded HDI intellectual property is licensed without an express right to modify it.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: The licence to embedded HDI intellectual property does not grant sublicensing rights, so the Company lacks an express right to sublicense the complete Deliverables.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: No licence or other right in the Company's Content or site data is granted to HDI, so the condition requiring limitation of any such licence is demonstrably absent.
